statements.text:
Amid the chaos and the fight to stop Trump's reckless war in Iran, we secured important wins in this year's Senate defense bill, including:

➡️ A pay raise for service members
➡️ Guardrails on AI use for domestic surveillance and nuclear weapons
➡️ Over $160 million for New York priorities

At the federal level, my mission is to ensure AI innovation benefits every American, not just a powerful few. That requires establishing clear, reliable rules of the road. We must build a framework that protects our kids from harmful algorithms and social media tools; shields seniors and consumers from AI-driven scams and fraud; and safeguards American jobs and livelihoods from displacement.

statements.text:
Between dignified senior care and essential pediatric checkups, Medicare & Medicaid touch nearly every family in America.

Bolstering these programs is a top priority for me in the Senate, and I'm committed to fighting Trump's reckless attacks on your healthcare.

statements.text: In 2025, seniors lost nearly $8 billion to scams. That’s up over 50% from the year before, due in part to the increasing sophistication of AI technology.
